title: “It’s my data, and I’ll cry if you lose it.”
summary: From corporate data to private medical information, Lantronix has done research to ensure their networking devices are secure and keep your data private.
body_markdown:
May 11, 2023


- [My Perspective](https://www.lantronix.com/blog/category/my-perspective/)


### “It’s my data, and I’ll cry if you lose it.”


A lot of personal data is gathered on each and every one of us, and it is routinely traded, sold and otherwise shared. There isn’t a lot we can do to stop it but it would sure be comforting to know that when personal information is transmitted, it is done in a secure fashion. This transmission can take place over a wireless or wired LAN network, or in person. In the[medical](https://www.lantronix.com/solutions/medical.html) space, government rules like the[HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules](https://www.hhs.gov/ocr/privacy/) demand that your private medical information be kept private.


To that end, here at Lantronix we have spent a lot of time including methods to make it easy for people implementing our products to send data securely using well- established encryption and authentication standards such as the recently updated[FIPS197 (AES)](https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.FIPS.197-upd1) , IPsec and higher-level protocols like SSL and SSH. Wireless adds another level of concern, but we have spent man-years implementing the latest security methodologies to keep your data safe – even over the air.


As your personal information is placed on a network, it’s nice to know that some nefarious individual cannot decipher the data stream due to solid data security practices that have been put in place.
